title: PPT Design Skill theme
description: Machine-readable theme contract. Colors are 6-hex without '#' (PptxGenJS convention) or 'r,g,b' triplets for derived RGB tokens. Validated by scripts/theme.py validate; enforced on decks by scripts/qa/token_check.py.

name.description: kebab-case; must match the filename <name>.theme.json (resolver looks themes up by filename)

review.description: true = extract draft, mappings need human confirmation before use

notes.description: extract draft: per-mapping provenance and what to double-check

colors.description: semantic tokens; ink/paper/accent required, extras free-form (paperTint, inkTint, accentLight, grid, accentRgb ...)

fonts.description: Office-safe fonts only (design-system.md § 字体体系)
